## What should the agent be able to do
The capability, from the agent's point of view.

## When should it trigger
The situations that should invoke the skill (this becomes the `description`).

## New skill or addition?
- [ ] New skill under `skills/<name>/`
- [ ] Addition to an existing skill (which one:            )

## Notes
Relevant endpoints, docs, or product surfaces this would build on.
